1. **F1 — High, blocking, issue-impact:** A pinned document’s internal link is accepted without checking its pinned commit whenever the target path is registered as any document in the current repository. [`validate_link_at`](crates/jit/src/document/link_validator.rs:134) returns `Valid` from `all_document_paths` before consulting `holds_target`; that set is built from all current references in [`check_document_links`](crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1100). Thus a pinned document can link to a registered target introduced after its pin and `check-links` reports it valid, contradicting the delivered “internal links resolve at the pin” behavior. Existing coverage only exercises an unregistered target.
